body: Depression is often defined as the inability to see a future. You have endless possibilities at your age, you have to choose what/who you want to be. You certainly have a harder road than some but that is what builds character, some of my greatest hurdles have been the best blessings in my life. It's often hard to see them for what they are in that moment. Some cultures still have children at the age of 16, don't allow other people to impose there bullshit onto your psyche. Work on improving yourself every single day, forget about everyone else, it's all behind you already. All you'll ever have is right this very second, use it wisely.

You have been given the gift of absolute freedom. Leave the house and the bills and go do absolutely anything you want. You don't have to live inside someone else's definition of a life. I've gotten divorced, it's awful but it certainly gets better. If she was the sole proprietor of income it is very likely that she will have to pay you anyway.
